purpose: Only a bounded, nonblocking one-shot compositor cue beside PR52 immediate phased move; no captures/host windows/VD/input changes.

patches.after:
private val swapAnimator = WorkspaceSwapAnimator(context)
    private val oneShotSwapMotion = StageOneShotSwapMotion(context)
